description:
Cast Finale of Devastation by paying {3}{G}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Riku by paying {U}{R}, copying Finale of Devastation.
Resolve the copy of Finale of Devastation, searching your library and/or graveyard for Biovisionary and putting it onto the battlefield.
Riku triggers, causing you to pay {U}{G} to create a token copy of Biovisionary.
Resolve the original Finale of Devastation, searching your library and/or graveyard for Mirror Image and putting it onto the battlefield as a copy of Biovisionary.
Riku triggers, causing you to pay {U}{G} to create a token copy of Mirror Image, which enters the battlefield as a copy of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, causing you to win the game.
